asks: Does the model answer the question, and both one-hop questions, right?
what_happened: Two-hop: says “Percussion” (right answer “Percussion”, P = 0.47). Hop 1 “Which instrument did Ringo Starr play in the Beatles? Answer in one word.” → “Drums”. Hop 2 “To which family of instruments do the drums belong? Answer in one word.” → “Percussion”.

asks: Is every edited word a single token?
Does removing the answer's own direction kill it, and from which layers?
what_happened: Remove the answer “Percussion” itself: first kills it in layers 6–11 (P 0.47 → 0.18, drop 0.61). That's where the model starts writing the answer.

asks: Same question, asked to name the bridge first: does removing the bridge (before the answer onset) kill its name?
what_happened: Ask “To which family of instruments does the instrument Ringo Starr played in the Beatles belong? Answer in one word. First name the instrument.” with the reply starting “The instrument is” (model continues: “the **drum kit**”). Remove “drums” in layers 0–5 → P(“drums”) goes 0.22 → 0.02. Drop 0.92.

asks: Does removing the bridge, before the answer onset, kill the answer?
what_happened: Remove “drums” in layers 0–5 → P(“Percussion”) goes 0.47 → 0.26. Drop 0.45.

asks: Is that drop bigger than removing everyday words of the same strength?
what_happened: Biggest drop from 12 everyday words: 0.15 (“barrel”, layers 0–5). Bridge 0.45 − noise 0.15 = 0.30 (pass ≥ 0.5).

asks: Does the bridge start to matter at least 3 layers before the answer does?
what_happened: “drums” first matters from layer 21; the answer “Percussion” from layer 6 → -15 layers earlier.

asks: Does removing the bridge matter more than removing another word of the same kind (another city, another animal)?
what_happened: Remove “piano” (same kind) → P(“Percussion”) goes 0.47 → 0.39. Drop 0.16. Bridge 0.45 − 0.16 = 0.29 (pass ≥ 0.3).

asks: Does the same edit leave unrelated questions alone?
what_happened: Same edit (layers 0–5): “What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer in one word.” → P(“Au”) 1.00 → 1.00; “What is the largest planet in the Solar System? Answer in one word.” → P(“Jupiter”) 0.95 → 0.93. Biggest drop 0.03 (pass ≤ 0.1).

asks: What if the bridge is removed over many layers at once?
what_happened: Remove “drums” in layers 8–23 → P(“Percussion”) 0.47 → 0.16 (drop 0.66); in all layers → 0.02 (drop 0.96).

test: 7b · Bridge's own part vs its kind (reported)
asks: Remove only the part of the bridge NOT shared with any same-kind word: does the answer still collapse?
Does removing only the part of the bridge not shared with the answer still kill it?
Swap in another word: does the answer become that word's answer?
what_happened: 0 of 7 swaps gave the swapped word's own answer (fallback answer with the bridge removed: “Percussion”).

asks: Swap in a word with the same answer: is the answer kept?
Need × specificity × isolation (0 if the bridge doesn't come first)
what_happened: Need 0.30 (drop beyond noise) × specificity 0.63 (share left when only the bridge's own part, not shared with same-kind words, is removed) × isolation 0.31 (share left when the part shared with the answer is kept) = 0.00 → 0 because the bridge doesn't act before the answer.
